authorized_openings.scope: One provider-free local typed Clinician One adapter may read only the current selection from a task-created authored-synthetic Word fixture after an explicit click and exact single-use grant; no existing document, patient/clinical data, whole-document read, provider, backend, microphone, write, deployment or release authority.

notes: The adapter is a non-authoritative client-local context frame, not GraphQL, a REST command, Access AI or an agent action.
The accepted Office host profile establishes capability only and retains document_read=false; the exact local fixture grant remains separate.
Authenticated Word Online and real installed-Word selection behavior remain unproven.
Provider, patient, clinical, backend, database, microphone, document-write, command, production, deployment and release gates remain closed.

claim_scope: Dependency-injected Word desktop and web fixtures each admitted one exact authored-synthetic current selection as a typed deeply immutable current_consult_note frame.
The adapter reads only context.document.getSelection().text, rejects instead of truncating, consumes a request identifier before access and performs no second read on replay.
Mobile, unknown, missing-host, invalid request/grant, empty, oversized, over-line and sanitized read-error cases fail closed.
The default-off localhost taskpane card requires authored-synthetic acknowledgement and renders only source, host and counts; selected text is not rendered or durably retained.
An ordinary-browser rendered check remained disabled after attestation because Word capability was absent; it made zero document reads and is not Office-host evidence.

contract_evidence.note: The clinician adapter adds no appointment context, proposal or command path and leaves the accepted Reception One intent contract unchanged.
The selection-only client adapter neither reads nor alters Diary events, freshness, availability or reconciliation behavior.

decisions.summary: Accept one provider-free single-use current-selection adapter and counts-only default-off card while every real-data, provider, backend and write boundary remains closed.

title: Clinician One Read-only Document Context
unresolved_gates: No real installed-Word selection or authenticated Word Online behavior is proven.
The local authored-synthetic fixture grant is not production authentication or clinician-role authorization.
Real/product-derived patient, health and clinical text remain closed.
Provider, Access AI, backend, database, microphone, document-write, clinical-command, production, deployment and release remain closed.
